title: Weekend AI Dev and Chill
author: fisj
selftext: A weekly post for everyone to chat and discuss what AI dev related things they saw or thought about recently. Hang out and chill with the community!

comments.author: fisj
comments.body: I'll start. Hot take "AI 3D asset generation is actually decent for basic models and should be used more". Also, video models just exploded in the last few weeks, most people have no idea how good they are now.

replies.author: PM_ME_UR_PIKACHU
replies.body: Which ai 3d asset generator are you using mate ?

replies.author: fisj
replies.body:
I really like:  
  
TripodSG: [https://github.com/VAST-AI-Research/TripoSG](https://github.com/VAST-AI-Research/TripoSG)

Trellis: [https://github.com/microsoft/TRELLIS](https://github.com/microsoft/TRELLIS)

There's Hunyuan 3D 2, but the license is not great: [https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hunyuan3D-2](https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hunyuan3D-2)

replies.author: PM_ME_UR_PIKACHU
replies.body: Thank you gonna check these out

comments.author: fyrean
comments.body:
Do you guys use free huggingface spaces much in your gamedev workflow? There are a lot of cutting edge free AI models there that runs on super powerful H200 gpus!

  
For example you can use any of the text to image models to generate a concept of a character or prop, and Trellis to create the full 3D model for your game, all on HF.

comments.author: creatormaximalist
comments.body:
I’m biased cause I’m helping build this tool, but I’ve been using Bezi to help me build my side project. It’s been awesome so far and I’ve officially stopped using ChatGPT now cause it just can’t beat the context that Bezi has of my project.

We also hung out with a bunch of game devs a couple weeks ago for a weekend game jam and it was pretty insane to see what people could build with Bezi in 72 hours.

comments.author: Lemon30
comments.body: Trying out how good Cursor is with pixijs. It's not doing too well with v8 so far but v7 seems to be okayish.

replies.author: fyrean
replies.body: I tried the same thing but with Cline instead of Cursor, works well if you copy paste the v8 migration guide to a markdown document and give it to the AI first.

replies.author: Lemon30
replies.body: Hmm, good to know. I ended u switching to phaser and it seems to be okay so far

comments.author: SteelFishStudiosLLC
comments.body:
Very little progress on the AI tools and components to our game, but we have stuff present in case we plan to push forward with it (which we do). We're VERY new to AI R&D, so it's kind-of an uphill struggle for us...

But we do see the grand potential for AI as a labor assistant and we want to take full advantage for our projects, both to make games faster and to do bigger and better things for game development

comments.author: stuffedcrust_studios
comments.body: New Flux Kontext model is pretty great for image editing and character consistency. Been using it to create new poses of character sprites from ChatGPT.
